title: India Mining Week Rescheduled to 24-26 February 2027
body_text:
The India Mining Week, originally scheduled for 15-17 November 2026, will now be held on 24-26 February 2027 at Yashobhoomi Convention Center, New Delhi.
The decision follows consultation with industry partners, exhibitors, speakers and government stakeholders. The revised dates avoid overlapping with other major industry and government events, and will ensure maximum participation from ministries, PSUs and global delegates. It also avoids the festive and winter travel period, making it easier for delegates and international visitors to attend.
What this means for participants
All registrations, exhibitor bookings and sponsorship commitments will be automatically transferred to the new dates. Delegates and exhibitors who cannot attend on the new dates may contact India Mining Week team to discuss options. The venue, programme themes and format remain unchanged, unless announced otherwise. Updated schedules, speaker announcements and other details will be shared on the Official Website of India Mining Week and through official channels.
India Mining Week brings together mining companies, equipment and technology providers, policymakers, investors and industry experts to discuss the future of the country’s mining sector. The flagship mining event, through its exhibition, conference and business networking sessions, will showcase new technologies, sustainable practices and investment opportunities across the mining value chain.
